# MLJAR Studio

> > MLJAR Studio is a private AI data lab for local machine learning experiments, AutoML training, and interactive notebook deployment without cloud uploads.

MLJAR Studio provides a desktop application for data scientists and analysts to build, train, and deploy machine learning models locally. The platform features automated machine learning (AutoML) capabilities, an AI Data Analyst for intelligent data exploration, and Mercury for converting Python notebooks into interactive web applications.

## Key Topics

- AutoML
- Machine Learning
- Python

## Core Products

- [MLJAR Studio](https://mljar.com): Private AI data lab for local ML experiments and analysis
- [AI Data Analyst](https://mljar.com/ai-data-analyst): AI Data Analyst product for private local data analysis without uploads
- [AutoML](https://mljar.com/automl): Automated ML pipeline training with XGBoost and CatBoost
- [Mercury](https://mljar.com/mercury): Deploy Python notebooks as interactive web apps for non-technical users
